verdict.rationale: Factory offers several programmatic surfaces. There is an OpenAPI spec and a Sessions API to create and drive Droid sessions. The Droid SDK runs the same agent harness that powers the CLI, desktop app and web platform. The CLI and `droid exec` expose the same runtime headlessly, including Missions, readiness commands and usage limits. However, no documentation claims full API/UI parity, and several UI-centric features have no evidenced API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, API coverage for Software Factory coverage maps and automations, design mode and inline review actions, session defaults and settings, adoption/usage analytics exports, and independent hands-on corroboration.
